content: Exakere niraehitiya naokowita: Kalorexe ityani xoimitatere xowaka atyo wakahare akereta tyaonita, tyotya hanexe xiyehare xekohasehare tehitiya xakore hoka.
Xoimitatere xowaka haiyaharenae aotyakijitene, exahe ixiyehare harenae kaxaikota enexe xaimenekolaose kijiya. Hoka hatyo enexe xaimenekolaose hikoahena hoka kalorexe tyaonita.
Nikareta tehitiya wiyoimitatere wawenane kakoa xowaka isekohaliti ali waikohekoa kaxaikotyasehare aokitere akereta ene wisaonita.
Hatyaoseta xane enaose hikoa hoka Enore axikatya Haisani. Haloti tyakota tyaona hoka judeunae xaotyakisakaho xema tyaona,
iyeheta maheta judeunae xaotyakisakaho xema tyaoniterenai hoka Enore ityaninae wisaona maheta.
Hotikisa maheta womana haisaninai aohenere wiso, Enore axikatya Haisani Nisekohare womana hoka hatyo Isekohaliti kawijita: “Abá, abá”, nita.
Nikare hoka maisa atyo wakaharenaeheta xini xiso. Ityaninae atyo xiso. Koxaka atyo ityaninae xisaona hoka haisaninae ana isa aokowitereharenae atyo ite isa xomana.
Paulo Mawaiyehare Gálatas Yerenai Kakoa
Toahiya Enore maniya ximawenaneharetatere xowaka ene enore metalaharenae wakaneharenae xisaonita. Maisa atyo aliterexe enoreha xini.

Xakore hoka kalikini atyo Enore maniya xisaonita, exahe Enore aoka xiso haomanere maheta. Nikare hoka xoana hoka xahaikoaheta xaokowita hatyo isekohaliti maiyaterehare tyaoniterenae ana, exahe xoalini hare maomanehare ana xaokowita? Xoana hoka ewakaneharenae xisaona xaokowihitiya?
Xoana hoka haiyaki ferakene, mijini, kamaikene, enonene, terehokoane masakare waiyeta xomana?
Nomawaiyehareta kalore xikakoa. Xoana naotyakihenere xiso ala maisa xoarehare tyomita xomana?
Nohinaeharenae, kasani natyo akereta xisaona naokita. Xiyaiya, xiso akerexeta natyo. Exahe maisa xoare iniyalahare xisomita nokakoi.
Xoana xotita hetati Iraiti Waiyexe noxakaihenere xihiye? Hatyo xowaka nohokakita hoka notyoa xinali hoka noxakai xihiye Iraiti Waiyexe.
Nohokakita hare hoka kahare nahakakisa xiso xakore hoka maisa xahalakijita, maisa xikirawaneta natyo. Waiye xamoka natyo, anjo Enore nalitare akereta, Jesus Cristo akereta xamoka natyo.
Exowaka ene xihalahare xisaonita. Exakere ite nomi: kaxaitoakisakereya xiyosenai hoka xaitoakiseniya hoka xiseniya nomani! Hoka hatyo najikinita xoana xisaona?
Xoana kalikini ala xahalakoahare notyaona aliterexe niraihenere hiyeta?

Exe halitinae waiyexehare tyaonahitaha xiyahita, xakore hoka maisa atyo waiye maniya xini exahekolaha tyaonita. Kasani atyo kikihenahitaha xiso nonitita aokowitaha hoka exemaha xisaona maheta noximi maniya xisaonitere akereta.
Waiyeya mokahitaha xiso, waiyeya ahekotyaha xikakoa nohaotita, exahe nomakanihena hoka ehekoreya.
Nohinaehare, noxiyakawalinae: hatya ohiro kaisaniro hiye ityani kawetere akereta noxamaikohalini nokihixita xihiyeta. Heko ite namaikoharehena Cristo koamaniya xikinatere xisaohenere kijiya.
Kalikiniya nali xihaliya notyaonita hoka hahekoreya nirae xikakoa. Kalore nomawaiyehareta xikakoa.
Agar, Sara Xoaha Xaimenekola
Xiso xaotyakiyaho xema xisaona xaokowiterenae: xiraihena hoka nasema. Xoana maisala xasemita xaotyakiyaho iraehenerehare?
Exakerexe xakai: Abraão hinama mokose kaisani aoka. Hatya atyo wakahalo Agar ityani, hatya atyo exanityo kaiserehare Sara ityani xoaha.
Wakahalo ityani atyo ekaisanisakahare kaiserehare hoka exanityo ityani atyo Enore isa enomana aokowihenere.
Hatyoharenai atyo aimenekoita: Hinamahalo atyo aimenekoita hinama wenati tahi akiti. Tyairi Sinai atyo Agar hotikijita. Hatyo aimenekoitere hiyeta nawenanenae atyo wakaharenae.
Agar atyo aimenekoita tyairi Sinai, Arábia koa nali, exahe Agar aimenekoita tehitiya wenakalati kalikiniye Jerusalém. Hatyokoare hotyalinai atyo tyotyaha wakahare tyaonahitaha.
Hoka Sara atyo aimenekoita wenakalati Jerusalém enokoa tyaonitere. Hatyo atyo maisa wakahalo xini hoka wityo atyo.
Hiyaiya, exakere atyo Iraiti Waiyexe nexa:

content.text: Hiso ohiro, maisa kahare kaisanihenolo: Maika hihalahalohena! Hiso maisa xoana xowaka xoima kahe kakoa hiwaolitihenolo: Maika hakawiyahena hihalahalone kakoa. Hiyaiya, ohiro ehalakisakahalo atyo ite kahare kaisanihena exanene kakoa tyaonitolo nonitata.

content: Hoka xiso nohinaeharenae atyo Isaque akereta, Enore ityaninai, iraehenere Abraão kakoa hiyeta.
Hatyo xowakiya ekaisanisakahare tyaohenere kirawaneta xoima Enore Nisekohare hiyeta tyaohenere. Nikare atyo kalikini kawenatyakita.
Xakore hoka aliyakerexe Iraiti Waiyexe nexa? Exakerexe atyo nexa:

content.text: Haxikahetehena wakahalo, ityani kakoita. Hiyaiya, wakahalo ityani atyo ite maisa hanexe wenekoare tyaonita. Mawakahalonehalo ityani atyo ite hanexe wenekoare tyaona.

content: Hatyo hiyeta, nohinaeharenai, maisa atyo wakahalo ityani xini wiso, xakore hoka ohiro mawakahalonehalo ityaninae atyo wiso.
